verdict.rationale: Stagehand's act() executes natural-language actions with no selectors, and observe() discovers actionable elements as structured, validatable actions. A selfHeal option re-infers an action when its recorded selector breaks, and act handles iframe and shadow DOM traversal automatically, all built on hybrid accessibility-tree understanding. Community commentary describes the code as self-healing and more resilient to DOM changes than hardcoded Playwright selectors. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that actions survive real selector/layout changes (the resilience claim in comm-8 reads as vendor-side commentary).
